rollups.text: Math 215 section change: On 2023-03-17, Nahom Mekonen wanted to move from Section 1 to full Section 2 because Section 1 conflicted with another desired class. The professor approved the change and advised him to contact registration or the department for an override; Nahom also sought a follow-up when the professor had not replied and time was running short. The records do not confirm that the switch was completed.

Surname and personal website plans: On 2023-03-12, Nahom Mekonen was updating his LinkedIn profile to reflect a new name, considering a custom-domain email address, and exploring a website about family history and his surname change. He leaned toward Wix and considered adding a blog about the experience and advice for others. He asked how long a beginner might need to build a basic Wix site; the estimate provided was 4–6 hours. The records do not confirm that the website or name change was completed.

Mother’s diamond ring appraisal: On 2023-03-21, Nahom Mekonen said his mother’s old diamond ring had been in his jewelry box for months and asked what to expect from an appraisal and whether to seek multiple opinions. He planned to take it to a newly opened downtown jewelry store on 2023-03-25 and asked how to assess the appraiser’s reliability. The records establish the plan, not that the appraisal occurred.

Running shoes and tracker: On 2023-03-18, Nahom Mekonen bought new running shoes and said the next day that he was enjoying them. By 2023-03-19, he identified them as ASICS Gel-Kayano 28 shoes, which felt good on morning runs and provided cushioning and support, with less foot fatigue and strain during longer runs. He chose the Garmin Forerunner 245 Music for running and outdoor activities; the records do not confirm when he acquired the tracker.

Fitness activities and tracking: Nahom Mekonen attended a morning Pilates class on 2023-03-15 and later explored workout breakfasts, a fitness tracker, a yoga mat, home Pilates resources, and a Pilates ball on 2023-03-21. By 2023-10-15, he reported spin class every Wednesday and Friday from 7:00–8:00 a.m., Pilates on Saturday mornings from 10:00–11:00 a.m., and using a fitness app to log workouts, calories, and progress. He planned post-spin stretching, core exercises on other days, and recovery snacks.

By 2023-10-15, Nahom Mekonen’s fitness app showed more than 10,000 calories burned in the preceding three months and a 5-pound weight loss. He aimed to reach 15,000 calories burned by the end of June, but the year for that deadline was not specified; completion is not recorded.

Wedding planning: After walking down the aisle as a bridesmaid at a cousin’s wedding on 2023-03-31, Nahom Mekonen began thinking about his own wedding and wanting an equally intimate atmosphere. He considered a small fall wedding at a countryside bed and breakfast or a city art museum, possibly planning without a wedding planner. He and his partner brainstormed a meaningful song, a love-story reading or poem, a unity candle or sand ceremony, and personal vows. No venue or date was confirmed.

December Hawaii family vacation: By 2023-04-05, Nahom Mekonen was planning a week-long December 2023 trip to Oahu and Maui with family, including a 9-year-old child. The child was especially excited about snorkeling at Hanauma Bay, which Nahom said he would book in advance. Nahom explored family accommodations with separate bedrooms and living areas, child-friendly activities and restaurants, and luaus. He said he would check a Hyatt Regency Maui Luau package described as including Santa and holiday crafts and was planning to book it, but the records do not confirm that any bookings or the trip occurred.

Statistical arbitrage learning: On 2023-04-02, Nahom Mekonen asked for explanations and Python examples comparing cointegration and correlation. He then requested ideas for an engaging course on statistical arbitrage using Python and open-source packages. The proposed curriculum covered data preparation, exploratory analysis, mean-reversion and momentum strategies, backtesting, portfolio risk, and advanced topics; no course launch or enrollment is recorded.

Japanese Alps trip planning: Nahom Mekonen planned a November 2023 trip focused on Nagano Prefecture, with autumn foliage, scenic routes, traditional culture and history, and the Japanese Alps Visitor Center in Matsumoto as interests. He chose Matsumoto as a base and planned to visit the visitor center, Matsumoto Castle, and Nawate Street, with the Folkcraft Museum and Zenko-ji Temple as possible additions. He considered inviting friends from Tokyo and asked about transit from Tokyo; no travel arrangements or final choice between Matsumoto Castle and Zenko-ji are recorded.

Life in Harajuku and Tokyo exploration: On 2023-04-11, Nahom Mekonen said he had lived in a new studio apartment in Harajuku for about a month, enjoyed the independence, and found the commute convenient. On 2023-10-15, he said he had been in Harajuku for three months, was still discovering the neighborhood, and had yet to visit Meiji Shrine. He enjoyed Tokyo’s fall foliage and exploring a new neighborhood each Sunday; the previous weekend he found a coffee shop in Daikanyama. He also planned a day trip to Yokohama, especially Minato Mirai 21 and the Red Brick Warehouse.

Thesis on social media and mental health: On 2023-07-21, Nahom Mekonen said he was stuck on the methodology chapter, especially data analysis, of his thesis. He considered combining survey data with social network analysis, with particular interest in community detection and links between online communities’ hashtag or keyword use and depression or anxiety outcomes. He also explored using machine learning to classify or predict mental-health symptoms from tweet content and network metrics. The records do not confirm a finalized method or completed thesis.
rollups.topic: social media and mental health thesis

rollups.text: Public-speaking development: Nahom Mekonen attended a public-speaking workshop at a downtown convention center in September 2023, led by Jane Smith. Group activities and role-playing emphasized active listening and effective questions, and Nahom said the workshop increased his comfort with those skills. By 2023-10-15, he was applying them in work meetings and noticed clearer articulation and better engagement with colleagues. He planned online practice, possible further in-person training, and at least one workshop or seminar per month.

Data-analysis learning and workplace sharing: By 2023-10-15, Nahom Mekonen had registered for an online data-analysis course starting the week of 2023-10-16 and hoped to apply the learning to a current work project. He was especially interested in visualization and statistical modeling, including Tableau and Power BI, and considered leading a team training or brown-bag lunch to share skills and practice public speaking. Completion of the course or training is not recorded.

Home-office and living-room changes: In June 2023, Nahom Mekonen cleared out his old college desk, bought an area rug, and had new living-room pillows and a coffee table; he considered rearranging his home-office furniture and preferred a balance of modern minimalist functionality and traditional coziness. On 2023-10-15, he rearranged the living room to create more space, a task that took about two hours with his roommate helping lift heavier pieces.

Photography learning: On 2023-10-01, Nahom Mekonen said low-light photos taken in early morning or evening had noise and blur. He had experimented with shutter speeds and apertures but had not tried a tripod, and asked about beginner tripod models and panhead versus ballhead. He used Lightroom and experimented with presets, including creating landscape presets. He also asked how to show motion in landscape images, especially water and clouds; advice included slower shutter speeds, a neutral-density filter, and a tripod.

Water-access project in Nigeria: On 2023-10-15, Nahom Mekonen planned a project to connect 100 rural Nigerian villages to running water. He requested a stakeholder analysis of potential beneficiaries and harmed groups, then impact indicators for groups including rural communities, governments, water organizations, healthcare, farming, schools, businesses, displaced residents, traditional water sources, environmental organizations, and small-scale water vendors. The records describe planning and proposed indicators, not project implementation.

Xiamen pollution and community action: On 2023-10-15, Nahom Mekonen expressed concern about air, water, and soil pollution in Xiamen and hoped public awareness and action would complement government efforts. He said he would look into organizing a community clean-up and asked how to make it effective and engaging. The assistant suggested setting goals, choosing a safe area, recruiting volunteers, providing equipment, and tracking results; no event is confirmed.

Exercise and fitness activities Nahom Mekonen has mentioned: morning Pilates class (2023-03-15); considering home Pilates exercises and online guidance (2023-03-21); considering a local running group (2023-03-19); spin class every Wednesday and Friday, 7:00–8:00 a.m. (reported 2023-10-15); Saturday Pilates, 10:00–11:00 a.m. (reported 2023-10-15); planned post-spin stretching and core exercises on other days (2023-10-15).

Health and fitness devices or services Nahom Mekonen uses or considered: Omron blood pressure monitor, used in the morning (2023-03-30); Fitbit account and interest in combining its data with other health measures (2023-03-30); Humidistat nasal aspirator, used regularly for sinus pressure and congestion (2023-03-30); Garmin Forerunner 245 Music, chosen for running and outdoor activities (2023-03-19); fitness app for workouts, calories, and progress (reported 2023-10-15); Fitbit Charge 3, considered but no purchase recorded (2023-03-21).

Jewelry and accessories Nahom Mekonen mentioned: his mother’s old diamond ring, which he planned to have appraised (2023-03-21 to 2023-03-25); a chain belt he considered ordering from Amazon (week of 2023-03-20 to 2023-03-26); and a silver pendant necklace bought for his sister’s birthday from a local Main Street boutique, for about $80 (reported 2023-10-15).

Gifts Nahom Mekonen bought or planned: silver pendant necklace for his sister’s birthday, about $80, from a local Main Street boutique (reported 2023-10-15); wine-and-cheese basket for neighbors’ belated anniversary, about $75, from a new neighborhood gourmet shop (2023-10-15); personalized Shutterfly photo album for his mother (reported 2023-10-15); Lego City Fire Truck set 60112 for a 9-year-old child (2023-10-15); and a Voluspa Santal Vanille candle he decided to choose as a possible coworker gift (2023-10-15; purchase not confirmed). He also planned a personalized graduation necklace and heartfelt letter for niece Emma (2023-10-15; completion not recorded).

Nahom Mekonen planned a gift fund of $50 per month and wanted to categorize spending into birthdays, holidays, special occasions, and spontaneous gifts. He said thought and effort matter more than a gift’s cost. Separately, he considered coworker gifts under $80 each and chose Voluspa Santal Vanille as a candle option; no purchase is confirmed.

Music preferences and listening interests: Nahom Mekonen enjoys a wide range of genres and was especially interested in indie folk by 2023-08-30. Fleet Foxes and Iron & Wine were already two of his favorite artists then; he was interested in exploring unfamiliar artists and songs. He also said on 2023-06-09 that Shaggy’s cross-genre sound and broad appeal were interesting.

Gardening interests and plants: On 2023-10-15, Nahom Mekonen said he was growing tomatoes, cucumbers, and bell peppers and was considering marigolds as companion plants to help control nematodes. He also considered adding succulents to a partially shaded patio arrangement and decided he would get an Aloe Vera plant for his living room, but did not confirm acquiring it.

Places Nahom Mekonen considered or planned to visit: Oahu and Maui for a family vacation in December 2023; Nagano Prefecture and Matsumoto for a Japanese Alps trip in November 2023; Minato Mirai 21 and Yokohama Red Brick Warehouse on a Yokohama day trip; Meiji Shrine and Kawai Shrine in Harajuku; and Tasmania as a future foodie destination (2023-10-06). These are plans or interests, not confirmation that the visits occurred.

Home and garden items Nahom Mekonen bought or considered: new ASICS Gel-Kayano 28 running shoes (2023-03-18); area rug bought at a discount store and awaiting installation (week of 2023-06-19 to 2023-06-25); new living-room pillows and a coffee table (reported 2023-06-24); and an Aloe Vera plant and planter, which he planned to acquire but had not confirmed purchasing (2023-10-15).

Nahom Mekonen’s fitness-tracker decision narrowed from considering a Garmin Forerunner and Fitbit Ionic on 2023-03-19 to choosing the Garmin Forerunner 245 Music the same day; later he considered a Fitbit Charge 3 for Pilates tracking on 2023-03-21, without stating a purchase. The records show a preference for the Garmin for running and outdoor features, not a confirmed purchase.
